title: Grateful Dead Live at McArthur Court, University of Oregon on 1969-05-31
lineage: Transfer info: Tascam DA-302 > Sound Devices 722 (digital transfer)
taper: Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear)
source: Bear’s Ampex cassette (or possibly reel) SBD master > DAT (provided by Anon)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with noticeable hiss, but an epic Baby Blue and a stellar Friend of Mine make this show unforgettable.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as stunning – especially the “Baby Blue” jam and the definitive rendition of “Friend of Mine.”  The recording is a sound‑board source that suffers from extra tape hiss compared with earlier transfers, though the overall mix remains listenable.  Fans describe the set as wildly psychedelic and highly recommend it despite the minor noise issue.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently lauded (high‑energy jams, standout songs) while recording quality is noted as having hiss; the weighted average yields a strong rating with moderate confidence from three detailed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable tape hiss and slightly less warmth than earlier transfers, but overall clear enough to enjoy the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as a nonstop psychedelic ride with seamless energy; reviewers highlight its overall stunning vibe and epic jams throughout.
